response: A, your fear makes sense. You asked to leave, and you were kept from the only exit for five minutes. Being blocked from leaving is a serious safety concern, and it's okay to name it that way. B, your panic about leaving things unresolved is real. But a conversation can't be resolved by keeping someone in a room. Physically preventing a partner from leaving isn't okay, even when the intent is to keep talking. One option is to agree ahead of time on a time-out rule: either person can leave, and you set a time to return to the topic. A, if you feel unsafe again, please reach out to someone you trust or a support line.
